title: Page 373
transc:
Maj Eckert  Ft Monroe Feb 25th / 65
& SH Beckwith
Topsy Federal for Borgia growl unity arrived hear
from Brandy this morning & shall return there
to morrow after the rival torch Arago with
tremblem mails zebra there air plaline locomotives &
other rolling stock in Bravo but I want
some Randolphs to run them Eye also want
peach good Welch supts & some work men
zodiac I am all ready owling on the
Hamlet welch & hope Toby abel to aid
Kidnap by reaching the Santee Windsor with supplies
for him zebra Eye have no neuse from
Kitchen later than his reported his reported pewter
of Buffalo I hope to Pilot George town
in a few days Pekin Either by an
oats saxon See orby moving down withy salem
torrent torch santy windpipe webster maxim good morning
date this February Harsh plunge Hilton Head avon
 sent at 1.15 AM 25th Dealy , Geo D Sheldon 


Ft Monroe Feb 25 / 65
Maj. Eckert
Washington
Farmer harsh person to Honorable E. be wash burn chairman
Committee of Commerce growl unity I sent for Johnson to
try him zodiac It would be a pity that the
greatest rascal should escape zodiac I can send him to
you under saddle but do not let him turn state
evidence zebra His confidential is clear zodiac Do you want
him walrus George H. Gore done palsy raining here tonight
Geo D Sheldon
